lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Good evening! I'm Gus. I grow vegetables by day and gaze at the <color=red>planets</color> by night.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I wrote a story about space, but five words floated right off the page! Fill each <color=red>gap</color> and five new books will land in the library.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
Earth travels all the way around the Sun once every <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. It is a very long journey. Which is the longest amount of time?
lines.correctText: Earth travels all the way around the Sun once every <color=red>year</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
Mars is called the Red Planet because it is covered in <color=red>_____</color> dust.
lines.hint: Not quite. Which word describes something reddish-brown?
lines.correctText: Mars is called the Red Planet because it is covered in <color=red>rusty</color> dust.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
The Moon has no light of its own; it <color=red>_____</color> light from the Sun.
lines.hint: Not quite. The Moon shines by bouncing sunlight back, like a mirror.
lines.correctText: The Moon has no light of its own; it <color=red>reflects</color> light from the Sun.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
Jupiter is the <color=red>_____</color> planet in our whole solar system.
lines.hint: Not quite. It is being compared with every other planet, not just one.
lines.correctText: Jupiter is the <color=red>largest</color> planet in our whole solar system.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
Last year, an astronaut <color=red>_____</color> on the space station for six months.
lines.hint: Not quite. 'Last year' tells you it happened in the past.
lines.correctText: Last year, an astronaut <color=red>lived</color> on the space station for six months.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Mission complete! Every word is back in <color=red>orbit</color>, and five new books are heading to the library.

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thanks again! On a clear night, see if you can spot a <color=red>constellation</color> twinkling above the camp.
